title: Poles-03 drive bearing fails repeatedly
problem: Bearing 6204 on the Poles-03 drive failed three times in 34 days (17 Aug, 02 Sep, 20 Sep). Each failure stopped the machine for 3 to 8 hours.
whys: The bearings ran with too little grease.
The lubrication interval is too long for the current load.
PM-0003 greases the machine every 30 calendar days.
Machine utilization rose from 12 to 18 hours per day in July.
rootCause: The PM interval follows the calendar and no longer matches machine utilization.

man: Shift B operators run the spindle at higher feed
machine: 6204 bearing runs near its rated load at 18 h/day
method: PM triggered by calendar, not runtime
SOP does not state grease quantity
measurement: Vibration checked by feel until July
environment: Polishing dust reaches the seal lip

actions.text: Replace both drive bearings and the oil seal
Add vibration reading to the weekly motor inspection
Change PM-0003 from every 30 days to every 400 runtime hours
Add grease quantity (8 g per bearing) to JP-POL-002
Brief shift B operators on feed rate limits

title: Oven 2 flame failure lockouts
problem: Oven 2 locks out on flame failure several times a month. Each lockout scraps the parts inside the oven.
whys: The flame detector signal drops below 2 µA.
Soot builds up on the detector and the nozzle.

method: No combustion analysis in the monthly service

actions.text: Clean detector and nozzle weekly until combustion tuning is done
Book Oven Tech for combustion analysis and tuning

title: Compressor 01 high temperature trips
problem: Compressor 01 tripped on element temperature 4 times in May and stopped plant air.
whys: The compressor room intake filter was clogged with dust.
Room intake cleaning was not in the PM.
rootCause: Compressor room ventilation was outside the PM scope.

method: No task for the room intake filter
environment: Dry season dust from the road side

actions.text: Clean cooler and room intake filter
Add room intake cleaning to JP-CMP-001
Replace manual drain with zero-loss drain

title: Light curtain bypass found on Press 200T
problem: During the March PM the light curtain on HPR-01 was found bridged with a jumper wire.
whys: An operator bridged the light curtain to clear jams faster.
Blanks jammed several times per shift.
Worn die guide pins misfed the blanks.
Guide pins were not in the PM checklist.
rootCause: Die guide pins were never inspected, so jams pushed operators to bypass the guard.

actions.text: Remove the jumper and retrain the crew
Upgrade light curtain to Type 4 with muting
Add guide pin check to JP-HPR-001

title: Repeated oil leaks at CK compressor cooler
problem: The cooler hose and fittings on CKR-CMP-01 leaked oil three times this year.
